references.text: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word
You shall not add anything to what I command you, nor take away from it. Keep the commands of the Lord your God that I am commanding you
Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter through it
The Lord says: Because this people draw near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men
